## otakumode.com (Information)

- https://otakumode.com/otapedia/games/final_fantasy/advent_children -- story, dates, credits -- accessed 2026-10-17 (fetched by me, text pasted by user; Tokyo Otaku Mode's Otapedia, sections Plot and Setting, Reception, Production Cast)
  - Plot: a 3D computer-animated science-fiction drama film of 2005, set two years after Final Fantasy VII, in the new city of Edge where Cloud Strife and Tifa Lockhart run a courier service and care for the orphans Denzel and Marlene; Cloud and Denzel are infected with the incurable disease Geostigma; Rufus Shinra asks Cloud to stop Kadaj, Loz and Yazoo, who want to resurrect Sephiroth with Jenova's remains; agrees with the entry's description (two years after VII, Cloud and the children infected with Geostigma); the rest is spoilers and not copied
  - Versions: it says a director's cut was announced about a year after the release and came out in April 2009 as Advent Children Complete, with nearly thirty minutes of extra footage, revised scenes and updated visuals; consistent with the entry's Complete primary version (subtitle year 2009) and its Director's Cut tag; mixed reviews noted; its Production Cast section and Reception are outside our scope; its Links section names the Rotten Tomatoes page below and https://www.square-enix.com/
